mintedBy: Bowman-family baseball checklist-gap acquisition (2026-09-21). Diagnosis of a ~300-sale sample of 2025 bowman-draft unbacked sold_comps rows found 67/300 (22%) unbacked; 19 of those were a wrong-key matcher defect (2025 Bowman Draft CHROME sales minting under setKey=bowman-chrome, out of scope for a checklist CSV -- flagged separately) and the remaining 48 were genuine ladder gaps on the Sapphire subset: CPA- prospect autos missing their Green/Gold/Orange/Black/Red/Padparadscha Sapphire rungs (e.g. CPA-SHA, CPA-GK, CPA-PF, CPA-CB), SS- Sapphire Selections inserts missing their own Gold/Orange/Red Sapphire + SuperFractor rungs (e.g. SS-5, SS-9, SS-14, SS-17), and BDC- base cards missing several Sapphire colour rungs (e.g. BDC-153, BDC-101, BDC-58, BDC-126, BDC-28, BDC-187, BDC-162, BDC-6, BDC-94, BDC-48). This package expands the FULL rosters (200 BDC-, 18 SS-, 30 CPA-, 15 SSA-, all read from the source's own xlsx workbook) against their own stated ladders and keeps only (cardNumber, parallel) pairs not already present in card_catalog under setKey=bowman-draft OR bowman-draft-sapphire (both checked; 3,238 existing distinct pairs found combined; 52 of the theoretical 1,497 rows were already covered and skipped).
settledSetKey: bowman-draft -- the sale-side hobbyiqCardId for these Sapphire sales mints under setKey=bowman-draft, not the sibling bowman-draft-sapphire (confirmed against a live sale sample: hiq:baseball:2025:bowman-draft:cpa-sha:green:auto, hiq:baseball:2025:bowman-draft:ss-5:base:no-auto). This CSV is filed under setKey=bowman-draft so its rows land at the SAME id prefix the sales already use; the sibling bowman-draft-sapphire key already carries a separate, overlapping set of rows from an earlier source and was checked (not written to) purely for dedup.
spellingAudit: Parallel names verbatim from the source page's four stated ladders (Base Draft Sapphire Checklist, Sapphire Chrome Prospect Autographs Checklist, Sapphire Selections Autographs Checklist, Sapphire Selections Checklist), cross-checked against existing card_catalog spellings for the same colour words under both bowman-draft and bowman-draft-sapphire (Yellow/Gold/Orange/Black/Red/Green/Padparadscha Sapphire, SuperFractor) -- identical, no alignment needed.
selectCardsOnlyAudit: No 'select cards only' / roster-restriction language on the source page for any of the four ladders; each applies to its full named roster (BDC- 1-200, CPA- all 30 signers, SSA- all 15 signers, SS- all 18).

provenance.cardsFrom: checklistinsider.com xlsx workbook (tabular-inferred layout via backend/scripts/scrape-checklistinsider.cjs), 263 total rows across all four subsets, verified against the HTML page's own numbered card-by-card lists for BDC-1..200
provenance.rungsFrom: the source page's own four stated ladders, verbatim, all rungs with print runs
provenance.dedup: existing card_catalog rows for setKey IN (bowman-draft, bowman-draft-sapphire), sport=baseball, cardYear=2025 were read via a bounded query pass (3,944 + 817 = 4,761 existing rows) and any (cardNumber, parallel) pair already present in either key was excluded from this CSV.
